name: @ship/deck-hono
description: Deck transport adaptor for Hono / Bun — the TypeScript sibling of deck-axum. Serves a `deck build` SPA output (index.html + hashed assets), the /_deck/* framework singletons, and /api token + theme CSS, mirroring deck-core's DeckResponse serve contract. Live-data SSE is host-owned (`config.live`). The serve core is framework-agnostic (Request -> Response); the Hono binding is a thin layer.
